tooling.message:
feat(check): explainer pages checked without JavaScript at the gate, and section anchors of an entry

## Intent

Check the explainer's promise of being readable without JavaScript at the gate too, so the listing validation and /review see it, not only the template's own tests. Catalog entries may link sections of a page, so make sure those links resolve.

## Key changes

- Pages marked as explainer pages are visited a second time with JavaScript off, in one shared browser context, on a bundle and on a deployed address; other apps get no extra visit and the rule is left out of their report.
- The new error rule explainer-readable-without-js checks an h1, that every heading, formula and figure is visible, every figure has an accessible name, every exercise has a non-empty Lösung and every component's nojs text is visible.
- An entry's topic page#section must name an element id of its page, read from the HTML as the server sends it.
- The explainer and app skills say which rules lernapps check now enforces; the plan records step 7.
- Tests in the fast set: a passing and a broken explainer fixture, proof from the server log that unmarked pages get no second visit, and the anchors.

## Dependencies and side effects

- lernapps check on an explainer bundle takes a fraction of a second longer; quiz and other bundles are unchanged.
